extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline, On this day, people and pets, places, albums and favourites of a self-hosted Immich server, or search by description. Watch them as a slideshow that crossfades and slowly pans and zooms across each photo, with photo details at the press of Info. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.3.9 - Folder backgrounds show the whole photo, on a blurred copy of itself, instead of a crop v0.3.8 - Years and months in Timeline, and countries in Places, show one of their photos v0.3.7 - Tile names are drawn properly with the Estuary skin's font v0.3.6 - Favourites that showed a tile go back to the Immich icon by themselves, keeping their place v0.3.5 - Tiles stay on the menu: Immich favourites no longer get one, so pick a thumbnail again for any that did - Kodi quits promptly even with a photo or tile request under way v0.3.4 - Kodi no longer waits long on a slow server when it quits while tiles are drawn v0.3.3 - Long tile names wrap onto two lines, so every name stays larger - Tiles redraw straight after an update v0.3.2 - Shuffle everything gets a photo tile too - A soft shadow keeps tile names readable on bright photos v0.3.1 - Photo tiles: the menu and Immich favourites show one of your photos with the folder's name, a new one each day - Rotated phone portraits zoom again on 4K screens v0.3.0 - Pausing eases the photo back to the whole picture and shows it at its sharpest - The caption, clock and Paused have an outline instead of a dark band along the screen edge v0.2.9 - Smooth zoom setting: stops sand, leaves and other fine detail from shimmering, on Kodi builds that support mipmapped textures

extension.summary: Play your RomM library with Kodi's built-in emulators
extension.description: Browse the ROM library of a self-hosted RomM server, download games and BIOS files on demand, and play them in Kodi's RetroPlayer using the installed libretro game add-ons.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a RomM server (5.0 or newer) that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the RomM project.
extension.news: v0.3.1 - Game backgrounds get a CRT look, with scanlines and plain as choices (Screenshot look, under Library) - A whole page's backgrounds are made at once, and console screenshots are shown 4:3 as on a TV v0.3.0 - Game backgrounds show the whole screenshot, sharp, on a blurred copy of itself, instead of a crop v0.2.11 - Tile names are drawn properly with the Estuary skin's font v0.2.10 - Favourites that showed a tile go back to the RomM icon by themselves, keeping their place v0.2.9 - Tiles stay on the menu: RomM favourites no longer get one, so pick a thumbnail again for any that did - Kodi quits promptly even with a request under way v0.2.8 - The shadow behind two-line tile names sits on both lines v0.2.7 - Bigger tile names; long ones wrap onto two lines - Tiles are redrawn right after an update v0.2.6 - Menu entries and RomM favourites show a game picture with their name, new each day (setting under Library) v0.2.5 - Downloads and unpacking cut short are redone instead of used half-finished - BIOS files are copied even when the server does not give their size - Clearer errors when the server drops the connection - Stop now cancels pairing - File names from the server stay inside the download folder v0.2.4 - Say when an emulator could not be enabled - Hiding platforms without an emulator keeps those Kodi can install one for

extension.description: Add-on repository for kel-mo's Kodi add-ons, such as RomM. Installing it lets Kodi find and update these add-ons automatically.

extension.summary: Shows your Home Assistant dashboard in Kodi
extension.description: Brings the contents of the Home Assistant "Home" dashboard into Kodi: your favourites, the light, climate, security, maintenance, weather and energy summaries, and every area grouped by floor. States update live over the WebSocket API, and devices can be switched straight from the couch.

Bringt den Inhalt des Home-Assistant-Dashboards „Home" nach Kodi: deine Favoriten, die Übersichten für Licht, Klima, Sicherheit, Wartung, Wetter und Energie sowie alle Räume nach Etagen gruppiert. Die Zustände aktualisieren sich live über die WebSocket-API, und Geräte lassen sich direkt vom Sofa aus schalten.
extension.news: v1.5.0.1 - Fixed: the dashboard could crash while states were changing - Fixed: camera stills stopped after half an hour with a user name and password - Fixed: the access token was sent to image servers other than Home Assistant - Fixed: a cancelled login or a rejected token left the dashboard reconnecting forever - Fixed: a network blip could force a new login, second factor and all - Fixed: a change made while connecting could be missed - Fixed: an IPv6 address in the Home Assistant URL - Temperatures and numbers take decimals where the entity steps in them; a thermostat holding a range asks for both ends - Summaries follow Home Assistant: the default ones appear even if the shortcut list was never edited, and empty ones are left out - The access token is hidden in the settings
